candidates.task: Natural-language task -> engine family -> capability (14 classes) or ABSTAIN.
candidates.why_native: Local, offline, cheap routing before any provider call; keeps task text on device.
candidates.data_source: blux-coga-dataset and blux-ca-dataset task instructions (owner-licensed, pinned commits); compiled as blux-routing-0.2 outside Git.
candidates.baseline: Deterministic keyword routing 86/124 (69.35%), macro F1 0.5302; majority baseline also measured.
candidates.architecture: TF-IDF + L2 logistic regression heads (CPU, <100 records); no pretrained weights.
candidates.training_config: training/router/ (seeded, frozen config, artifact policy); training/experiments/blux-router-0.1/.
candidates.holdout_evaluation: Router 0.1 failed its one-shot protected evaluation; Router 0.2 BLOCKED_DATA (no fresh protected families).
candidates.measurements: Best hybrid (learned family + keyword capability) 93/124 (75.0%) grouped development, gain interval 0 to 12.77 pp includes zero.
candidates.integration: Not integrated; Model API routing unchanged. Needs 694 independent owner-authored families (training/research/WAKE_UP_REPORT.md section 39).

candidates.why_native: Would only help on commands no rule anticipates.
candidates.data_source: evals/suites/policy.jsonl (36 owner-authored ground-truth cases); no larger labelled corpus exists.
candidates.splits: Not trainable: 36 cases are an evaluation suite, not a training set.
candidates.baseline: Deterministic blux_runtime.security.commands.detect: 36/36 after the Stage 36 wipe-rule fix (35/36 before), 0 false alarms.
candidates.measurements: Rule: p50 well under 1 ms, auditable, fails closed on unparseable input.
candidates.integration: Rejected: a learned classifier cannot beat an auditable rule at 100% on the suite and would weaken fail-closed behaviour. Improve the rules instead (as done for adb wipe).

candidates.task: Predict DAT's verdict (pass/fail) for a change.
candidates.why_native: None: DAT is the independent validation authority; prediction is not validation.
candidates.data_source: DAT reports inside blux-ca-dataset (10 gate verdicts in protected splits).
candidates.baseline: DAT itself: deterministic gate (fail_on, min_confidence), 4 pass / 6 fail exactly reproduced.
candidates.measurements: DAT verdicts reproduce exactly in the Gen 0 replay.
candidates.integration: Rejected: replacing or pre-empting DAT's deterministic verdict with a model would break the authority boundary (cA never certifies; DAT validates).

candidates.task: User request -> BLUX intent (diagnose, construct, repair, compare, plan, device, risk, analyze).
candidates.why_native: Local first-hop classification without a provider call.
candidates.data_source: None eligible yet; evals/suites/intent.jsonl holds 8 evaluation cases only.
candidates.baseline: BLOCKED: the external-model baseline needs provider credentials (docs finding F10).
candidates.architecture: If data arrives: the Router 0.x linear baseline first.
candidates.integration: Not possible until a baseline and an owner-authored corpus exist.

candidates.task: Task -> capability/tool to invoke (overlaps capability routing).
candidates.data_source: None beyond the routing corpus; evals/suites/tool_selection.jsonl has 6 cases.
candidates.integration: Blocked on the same data as capability routing.

candidates.task: Rank candidate repairs for a failing artifact.
candidates.why_native: Choose among cA candidates without a model call.
candidates.data_source: None: cA emits one changeset per step, so no candidate sets with outcome labels exist (6 repairs in the Gen 0 replay).
candidates.integration: Needs multi-candidate repair generation plus DAT/test outcome labels.

candidates.task: Rank candidate code patches by expected test/DAT outcome.
candidates.why_native: Cheap local pre-filter before running tests.
candidates.data_source: None: no candidate patch sets with test outcomes exist.
candidates.integration: Needs a patch-candidate corpus with recorded test and DAT outcomes.

candidates.task: Request -> CogA planning operation (plan, decompose, compare, rank, risk, analyze, critique).
candidates.why_native: Same as capability routing for the reason.* family.
candidates.data_source: The reason.* labels of the capability-routing corpus.
candidates.splits: See capability-routing (reason.rank has 3 train records, 0 validation).
candidates.trained: Yes, as part of the routing study.
